I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/upx`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
A bounds-checking error in PackUnix::find_overlay_offset (src/p_unix.cpp) allows a 4-byte read past the end of the input buffer via the little-endian 32-bit reader (get_le32 / N_BELE_RTP::LEPolicy::get32). Malformed input can trigger a heap-buffer-overflow read during unpack detection (PackUnix::canUnpack), leading to crashes (DoS) and potential information disclosure.
